# Demand for repayment of an inspection deposit

From: ⟦PERSON|Rhea Veldren⟧

To: Accounts team, ⟦ORG|Ripple Spur Engineering Ltd⟧ (the Firm)

Date: 7 December 2026

I request repayment of the GBP 320 deposit paid for an inspection that did not take place. Your cancellation message confirmed that no inspector was available on the agreed date. I declined the alternative appointment because it fell after the equipment had to be returned to storage.

Please provide repayment within fourteen days. If you contend that a deduction is permitted, identify the contractual term and explain the calculation. A general reference to cancellation costs does not establish that such costs were incurred when the cancellation originated with your own scheduling team.

Please send your written response to ⟦EMAIL|rhea.veldren@mallow-post.invalid⟧. My ordinary postal correspondence remains at ⟦ADDRESS|52 Mallow Lane, Durham⟧.

I have retained the booking confirmation, payment receipt and cancellation message. I am willing to consider a short explanation before taking further steps, but the request for information does not waive the repayment demand or extend its deadline automatically.

Yours faithfully,

⟦PERSON|Rhea Veldren⟧

Enclosures: payment receipt and cancellation confirmation.
